candidates.inspect_pack: The client demonstrably reused an old resource pack. Confirm the intended pack download before evaluating its rendering.
candidates.complete: The requested evidence image is visually verified and saved, with no remaining request.
candidates.fallback: Insufficient or contradictory evidence, unknown screen, generic failure without an established recovery, or further reasoning needed. Return to the parent agent.
